answer: Each identity's ripple bond is split: 80% locks for 30 days, 30% burns immediately on flag. Before the first jade, the agent must pass a commit-reveal liveness test — a hollow-tagged message signed over a fresh random value that no two identities can share. A fleet of N clones must run N independent liveness tests in real time; the public nonce registry makes any duplicate instantly flagable. Attacker cost: N liveness runs + N x 70% burn on first flag; honest cost: one liveness test + one bond, reusable every ripple cycle.
